text: 就是前40年的努力或者结果决定了后半生的幸福。
en: It is the effort or the results of the first 40 years that determine the happiness of the latter half of one's life.

text: 比如你选择的伴侣；
en: For example, the partner you choose;

text: 你在工作中的积累的经验、人脉、认知；
en: the experience, connections, and understanding you accumulate in your work;

text: 你拥有的资产，决定你40岁以后是否能够过的从容；
en: the assets you possess determine whether you can live at ease after 40;

text: 你对生活的态度，会让你的精神达到的程度；
en: your attitude towards life determines the height your spirit can reach;

text: 你对孩子的教育，大概率孩子的走向；
en: your upbringing of your children largely determines your children's direction;

text: 你自律的程度，养成的生活习惯，拥有的朋友圈子。
en: the degree of your self-discipline, the living habits you form, and the circle of friends you have.

text: 这一切基本在40岁之前完成，未来也很难有所突破了，毕竟大家都是普通人。
en: All this is basically completed before the age of 40, and it is hard to make any breakthrough in the future, after all, everyone is an ordinary person.

text: 40岁中年人的感悟，值得收藏
en: Reflections of a 40-year-old, worth collecting

text: 一，要始终相信这个世界上仍然有白头偕老，仍然有至死不渝的爱情，只是没有信心，让我有幸遇到。
en: One, always believe that in this world there are still those who grow old together, there is still love that remains unswerving until death; it is just that I have no confidence I will be fortunate enough to encounter it.

text: 二，要多点耐心，因为你想的那个人可能已经睡了，被子已经盖的好好的，还可能已经在做梦。
en: Two, be more patient, because the person you are thinking of may already be asleep, tucked in nicely under the blanket, and may already be dreaming.

text: 这个晚上你除了收获到孤独之外，没有任何东西留给你了。
en: This evening, apart from gaining a sense of loneliness, nothing is left for you.

text: 三，让一个人成长的所有事都是孤单的，不想长大，是很多人的想法。
en: Three, all the things that make a person grow are solitary; not wanting to grow up is the thought of many people.

text: 但我们又必须长大。
en: But we must grow up nonetheless.

text: 因为有很多责任需要肩负。
en: Because there are many responsibilities that need to be shouldered.

text: 四，有时候心里很感觉崩溃，别人看到可能是一件非常小的事情，但在自己的心里，却很难度过这道伤疤，总想把自己的苦处跟人诉说。
en: Four, sometimes one feels utterly broken inside; what others see may be a very small matter, but in one's own heart it is hard to get past this scar, and one always wants to pour out one's sufferings to someone.

text: 但其实世界上没有感同身受，只有冷暖自知。
en: But in truth there is no such thing as shared feeling in this world; only one knows for oneself whether it is cold or warm.

text: 五，最难过的不是半夜躲在被子里哭，而是梦里梦到两个人和好了，醒来的时候却有种失落感。
en: Five, the most painful thing is not crying hidden under the blanket in the middle of the night, but dreaming that the two of you have made up, only to wake with a sense of loss.

text: 这个世界上，你就是你。
en: In this world, you are just you.

text: 你痛，痛了自己。
en: You hurt, and it is yourself you hurt.

text: 你累的，也是你自己，没有人同情你，但也要生活下去。
en: The one who is tired is also yourself; no one sympathises with you, yet you must still go on living.

text: 就算有人同情你，也没有什么特别的，最后收拾残局的还是靠自己。
en: Even if someone sympathises with you, it is nothing special; in the end it is still up to yourself to pick up the pieces.

text: 七，每次到晚上的一个时间，心里总感觉很空。
en: Seven, every time a certain hour of the night arrives, one always feels a great emptiness inside.

text: 感觉好像被很多抛弃和不在意。
en: One feels as if abandoned and uncared for by many.

text: 寂寞，让你难以呼吸。
en: Loneliness makes it hard to breathe.

text: 不知道该如何生活下去。
en: One does not know how to go on living.

text: 九，很多事情不必去钻牛角尖，自己明白就好。
en: Nine, many things need not be pursued to an extreme; it is enough that you understand them yourself.

text: 不必多问，有的时候答案自己未必能够接受。
en: There is no need to ask too much; sometimes you yourself may not be able to accept the answer.

text: 有的人自己明白就好，不必去为他而难过，有的感情是不能强求的。
en: For some people it is enough that you understand yourself; there is no need to be sad for their sake, for some feelings cannot be forced.

text: 十，所有离开你的人，都是并非突然才决定离开你，如果他的心已经冷了，说明积累了很长时间。
en: Ten, all those who leave you did not decide to leave you suddenly; if their heart has grown cold, it shows that it accumulated over a long time.

text: 当你觉得一个结果很突然的时候，也不是突然，他可能已经酝酿很久了。
en: When you feel a result is very sudden, it is not sudden either; he may have been brewing it for a long while.

text: 十一，生活中如果我们愿意原谅一个人，并不代表是真的原谅他，而是不想失去他，只有假装原谅。
en: Eleven, in life, if we are willing to forgive someone, it does not mean we truly forgive them, but that we do not wish to lose them, and can only pretend to forgive.

text: 十二，每个人的心里都有它的故事，都有一个过不去的坎。
en: Twelve, everyone has their own story in their heart, and a hurdle they cannot get past.

text: 有一个忘不了的人。
en: There is someone they cannot forget.

text: 无论你多么爱对方，都应该明白，最后结局只有两种:要么是路人，要么是终点。
en: No matter how much you love the other person, you should understand that there are only two possible endings: either a passer-by, or the destination.

text: 十四，世界上没有什么事是不变的，时间久了，最初的那种感觉也会改变，所有的棱角也会被磨平，梦也会被冲淡。
en: Fourteen, nothing in this world is unchanging; as time passes, that initial feeling will also change, all sharp edges will be smoothed away, and dreams will fade.

text: 爱情这种东西，就更加的不稳定。
en: Love, as a thing, is all the more unstable.

text: 十五，假如曾经你真心的爱过一个人，花了很多的时间和经历。
en: Fifteen, if you have ever truly loved someone, spending much time and experience.

text: 等到后面，却还是曲终人散；有一个人对你承诺很多，经过很多事情，但是最后没有出现在你的生活里，那就放弃吧！
en: In the end, it still comes to the close of the music and the scattering of the people; someone made you many promises, went through much with you, but in the end did not appear in your life—then let it go!

text: 十六，如果心里有些伤痛，可以让时间来冲淡一切，多年以后，你会发现，以前的那些问题都不叫问题。
en: Sixteen, if there is some pain in your heart, let time dilute everything; many years later you will find that those past problems were not problems at all.

text: 上有老下有小。
en: There are the elderly above and the young below.

text: 死都死不起。
en: One cannot even afford to die.

text: 肩上没有千斤担，谁拿生命赌明天？
en: If there is no thousand-jin burden on one's shoulders, who would stake their life on tomorrow?

text: 40岁以前的烦恼，现在看来都不是事，
en: The worries before 40, seen now, are nothing at all,

text: 40以后，赚的钱多，烦恼真的可以少一点，
en: after 40, the more money you earn, the fewer worries you truly have,

text: 少年的心态，藏在中年超重的躯体里，
en: a youthful state of mind, hidden within a middle-aged, overweight body,

text: 心中有困惑，也不好意思去问别人了。
en: with confusion in one's heart, yet too embarrassed to ask others.

text: 社会的阅历会在我们想要单纯的时候提醒我们。
en: The experience of society reminds us when we wish to be naïve.

text: 年纪大了，只喜欢有结果的事，和说话算数的人，比起心动，我更喜欢心安。
en: As one grows older, one only likes things that bear fruit and people who keep their word; compared with a flutter of the heart, I prefer peace of mind.

text: 留不住的人和事太多了，尽力就好，不属于自己的归还给人海！
en: There are too many people and things one cannot hold on to; just do one's best, and return what does not belong to oneself to the sea of humanity!

text: 人生还那么漫长，做自己喜欢做的事，遇见自己想见且值得的人。
en: Life is still so long; do what you enjoy, and meet those you wish to see and who are worth it.

text: 84年离异男，儿子八岁，父母退休，家住江苏北部小城市，就是最穷的那个苏北小城市。
en: A divorced man born in '84, with an eight-year-old son, retired parents, living in a small city in northern Jiangsu—the poorest of those northern Jiangsu small cities.

text: 慢慢明白对错很多时候没有意义，明白挣钱才是第一位的，这里的明白，不是知道，而是成为行为标准。
en: Gradually I understand that right and wrong are often meaningless; I understand that earning money comes first—and here 'understand' does not mean knowing, but becoming a standard of behaviour.

text: 中年了，会看淡男女那点事，也看淡情感。
en: In middle age, one learns to take a detached view of matters between men and women, and of emotions too.

text: 做为一个中年屌丝，前前后后和十几个女性有过深入交流，有交往几年的，也有个把月的，你会发现，为情所困的时光越来越少，甚至波澜不惊，一个中年男人的小建议给年轻男性朋友们，好女人有，问题是也不一定合适你。
en: As a middle-aged diaosi, I have had in-depth exchanges with a dozen or so women, some relationships lasting years, some just a month or so; you will find that the time spent trapped by love grows ever shorter, even becoming utterly calm. A small piece of advice from a middle-aged man to his younger male friends: good women do exist, the problem is they may not be right for you.

text: 多赚钱，账户余额才是自己的底气
en: Earn more money; the account balance is what gives you true confidence

text: 多健身，健康身体才是享受生活的前提
en: Exercise more; a healthy body is the prerequisite for enjoying life

text: 用心爱孩子，有爱环境长大的孩子才是好孩子
en: Love your children wholeheartedly; a child who grows up in a loving environment is a good child

text: 对父母好，没有父母，家就没有了。
en: Be good to your parents; without parents, there is no home.

text: 想到了之前读到的一个故事。
en: I thought of a story I read before.

text: 在《永恒之王》（TheOnceandFutureKing）中有一个情节。
en: In The Once and Future King there is a scene.

text: 亚瑟第一次见到梅林，就十分惊讶。
en: When Arthur first met Merlin, he was greatly surprised.

text: 因为俩人才刚见面，梅林却已经把早餐都摆上了餐桌，瓜果丰盛。
en: Because the two had only just met, yet Merlin had already laid out breakfast on the table, with an abundance of fruit.

text: 似乎正在等着他的到来。
en: It seemed he was waiting for his arrival.

text: 他很好奇，就问梅林，你怎么知道我要过来。
en: Curious, he asked Merlin, 'How did you know I was coming?'

text: 梅林解释说，因为自己的经历。
en: Merlin explained that it was because of his own experience.

text: 正常人都是在出生后，一天天地向前生活。
en: Normal people live day by day, moving forward, after they are born.

text: 而他，却是逆向活着的人。
en: But he was someone who lived in reverse.

text: 自己出生在时间结束的时刻，逆向地往后度日。
en: He was born at the moment time ended, living his days backwards.

text: 也就是说，他总是知道会发生什么事情。
en: That is to say, he always knew what was going to happen.

text: 因为他这一切一切，他早已经历过。
en: Because all of this, all of it, he had already experienced.

text: 我想劫后余生的幸存者心态，大概就是这样吧。
en: I think the survivor's mindset after escaping death is probably something like this.

text: 对于许多在40岁前已经‘‘死’’过一次的人来说。
en: For many who have already 'died' once before the age of 40.

text: 自己已经活在了第二次生命里。
en: One is already living in a second life.

text: 往后余生只不过是从前镜像。
en: The rest of one's life afterwards is merely a mirror image of the past.

text: 今年刚刚步入40，很明显的感觉就是精力、体力明显下降，偶尔劳累一下几天都缓不过来。
en: Having just turned 40 this year, the most obvious feeling is a clear decline in energy and stamina; the occasional bout of tiredness takes several days to recover from.

text: 前几天单位有事熬夜到凌晨三点，第二天一天人都缓不过来,感觉疲乏，浑身上下都不舒服，镜子里的面孔也着实吓自己一跳。
en: A few days ago something came up at work and I stayed up until three in the morning; the next day I could not recover all day, feeling weary and thoroughly uncomfortable all over, and the face in the mirror truly gave me a start.

text: 和一个同事大姐说女人一旦到了四十岁直接不能熬夜不能受累，否则就成“鬼”了，大姐笑着说，等你过了四十五会更加“娇气”。
en: I said to an older female colleague that once a woman reaches forty she simply cannot stay up late or over-exert herself, or she becomes a 'ghost'; the older sister laughed and said, once you pass forty-five you'll become even more 'delicate'.

text: 除了身体之外心态也变了很多，之前好强，如今觉得什么都无所谓了，只想在现有的条件下努力让自己舒服，身心愉悦才事王道！
en: Apart from the body, one's mindset has also changed a great deal; previously competitive, now I feel it doesn't matter about anything, I only wish to make myself comfortable under existing conditions—physical and mental ease is the right way!

text: 人到四十生命过半，心态越来越平和，以前尽一切能力鸡娃，如今也能接受孩子的普通和平凡，不再焦虑娃的成绩。
en: At forty, life is half over; one's mindset grows ever more peaceful. In the past I pushed my child with all my might, but now I can accept my child's ordinariness and mediocrity, and am no longer anxious about the child's grades.

text: 毕竟孩子到了高中就不是自己能掌控的了，高中一切都的靠娃自己，作为家长尽心尽力就好。
en: After all, once a child reaches senior school they are no longer within one's control; in senior school everything depends on the child themselves—as a parent, just do one's utmost.

text: 这个社会不是人人都能进入名校，成为万人瞩目的焦点。
en: This society is not one where everyone can enter a prestigious school and become the focus of attention for thousands.

text: 其实只要孩子能有学上，能有一技之长立足于社会，和我们自己一样做个平凡普通的人就好。
en: In truth, as long as the child can go to school and have a skill to stand on in society, it is fine to be an ordinary, commonplace person like ourselves.
